title: Script comment density
description: Documentation rule — compares scripts by total step count, real comment steps and whitespace-only comments, with a comment-density factor for each. Complements the binary "Undocumented Script" rule by grading how well-commented substantial scripts are. Minimum step count adjustable via the header slider (default 10).
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A low comment density in a substantial script makes intent hard to reconstruct; whitespace-only comment steps inflate the apparent documentation without adding meaning.
rule.remediation: Add meaningful comment steps for the non-obvious sections (purpose, parameters, branches); remove empty comment steps that only pad the script.

meta.name: Script comment density
